{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse, relaxed fit, knee-length hem, deep emerald green, satin weave.
Pleated midi skirt, A-line cut, mid-calf length, charcoal gray, wool crepe blend.
Tailored blazer, single-breasted with notch lapels, hip length, forest green, lightweight wool gabardine.
Chunky leather loafers, rounded toe, ankle height, burnt orange, suede finish.
Gold geometric statement earrings and a slim velvet clutch in matching burnt orange.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an autumn evening date by blending professional polish with romantic warmth. The deep emerald green of the top and jacket complements the season while echoing the rich tones found in restaurant settings, creating a cohesive and elevated look. The pleated charcoal skirt adds texture and movement, preventing the silhouette from appearing too stiff for a romantic occasion. Finally, the burnt orange accessories provide a vibrant pop of color that reflects her wish to stand out without breaking the requested everyday formality level."}
